nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, write $c(m, j)$ for the unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind. The cyclic product number $H(n, k)$ is the quotient $c(n + 1, k) / \binom{n + 1}{2}$, rounded down to a natural number, when $n + k$ is even (equivalently, $n - k$ is even), and $0$ when $n + k$ is odd. Division by zero gives $0$, so $H(0, k) = 0$ for every $k$.

Then $2g + 1 \le n \le 4g$.
